mapper.select: select o.id as id, o.appointmentDate as appointmentDate, o.startTime as startTime, o.endTime as endTime, o.student as student, o.teacher as teacher, o.note as note, o.question as question, o.refuseResult as refuseResult, o.workSummary as workSummary, o.state as state, studentInfo.username as studentName, teacherInfo.username as teacherName from officehourevent o left join userinfo studentInfo on o.student = studentInfo.id left join userinfo teacherInfo on o.teacher = teacherInfo.id WHERE (o.student = #{id} OR o.teacher = #{id}) AND o.appointmentDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL #{time} MONTH) AND o.state IN (2,3,4,5,7) order by o.appointmentDate desc
